How much does it cost to rent a jet ski on Koh Samui? | Beach operators quote per jet ski for 15 or 30 minutes, so agree the price in writing first. Guided rides from Maenam cost 3,500 THB for 1 hour and 6,500 THB for 3 hours to Koh Phangan, and our Jet Ski Safari to Pig Island costs 9,950 THB per jet ski for two riders.
Are jet ski scams still a problem on Koh Samui? | Yes. Damage claims after beach rentals on Chaweng and Lamai still happen in 2026, and the UK government's travel advice warns that rental companies may hold passports against claimed damage. Film the jet ski before you ride, get terms in writing and prefer a guided ride.
Should I leave my passport as a jet ski deposit? | No, never. Offer a photocopy and a cash deposit with a receipt instead. A held passport is the main lever in jet ski damage disputes, and the UK government advises against handing it over.
Do I need a licence to ride a jet ski on Koh Samui? | Tourists are not normally asked for a boat licence for beach rentals or guided rides. On our Pig Island safari drivers must be 18 or older, and the briefing, practice and guide make up for the lack of a licence.
Does travel insurance cover jet skis in Thailand? | Often not. Many policies exclude jet skis, or cover them only with a licence or a licensed operator, and almost all refuse claims if you had been drinking. Check the water-sports and liability sections of your policy before you ride.
What should I do if I'm accused of jet ski damage on Samui? | Stay calm, don't pay cash under pressure, show your video from before the ride and call the Tourist Police on 1155 to attend. If you must pay to recover your passport, get a written receipt and report it afterwards.
Can children ride on a jet ski on Koh Samui? | As passengers only, with a fitted child life jacket: 8 or older on our Pig Island safari. Younger children are happier on the Pig Island speedboat tour, which visits the same islands.
Does the Pig Island jet ski safari run in the rainy season? | Usually, because the south and west coasts are sheltered from the north-east monsoon, but the guide may shorten the route on windy days. If we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or a new date.
